name: At a finish, a sign is only ever "did it work?", if anything
judge: An agent finishes a short fix, done. Boop plays the success, and may or may not hold something up.
reasonable: A pleased success, usually with no sign, or a sign asking whether it worked. A small glad sign that fits a finish is fine too. Mild to moderate size.
unreasonable: A failure, a cross or sad face at a fix that went well, or a sign about something unrelated.
